problem_summary.summary: Return the values of a binary tree grouped by level, with each level ordered from left to right.
problem_summary.input_output: Input: the root of a binary tree. Return a list of integer lists, one for each level; an empty tree returns an empty list.

brute_force.explanation: Perform a depth-first traversal with an explicit stack of nodes and depths. Push right before left so nodes are appended to each depth's list in left-to-right order.
brute_force.correctness_idea: Every node is assigned to its actual depth. The stack's right-before-left push order makes left children pop first, preserving left-to-right order among nodes at the same depth.
brute_force.time_complexity: O(n) — each node is visited once.
brute_force.space_complexity: O(n) auxiliary in the worst case for the explicit traversal stack; the returned level lists contain O(n) values.

optimized.explanation: Use a queue and process its fixed size at the start of each iteration as one complete level.
optimized.correctness_idea: The queue is maintained in breadth-first, left-to-right order. Capturing its size ensures children added during a level are deferred until the next level, so each output list contains exactly one level in the required order.
optimized.time_complexity: O(n) — each node enters and leaves the queue once.
optimized.space_complexity: O(w) auxiliary for the queue, where w is the maximum level width; output storage is O(n).

steps.condition: The queue initially contains only the root.
steps.action: Append 4 to the current level and enqueue its children left to right.

steps.condition: The two queue entries at the start of this step are exactly level 1.
steps.action: Append 2 then 6; enqueue their children in left-to-right order.

steps.condition: All four leaves are processed without adding children.
steps.action: Append the final level and finish.

edge_cases.handling: Return an empty outer list before starting traversal.
Return one level containing the root value.
Only existing nodes are queued, preserving the values that actually occur at the next level.
